senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; עָשָׂה)deed, act; practice; fact, event.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 4:9">Yeb. IV, 9</cite> <he>עד שיעשה … מ׳</he> until thy older brother takes action concerning her (v. <cite ref="H01060"><he>חֲלִיצָה</he></cite> a. <cite ref="J00039"><he>יִבּוּם</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Bava Batra 130b:8">B. Bath. 130ᵇ</cite> <he>אין למדין הלכה … ולא מפי מ׳ … הלכה למ׳</he> you dare not derive a law either from a theoretical decision or from an act (of your teachers) unless they declare their decision a rule for practical guidance.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 130b:8">Ib.</cite>, a. fr. <he>מ׳ רב</he> a practical decision is a teacher (a guiding precedent).
<cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 15:2">Yeb. XV, 2</cite> <he>וכמ׳ שהיה</he> and only in the same way as it (the precedent) happened.
<cite ref="Yevamot 116b:16">Ib. 116ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>משום מ׳ שהיה</he> on account of an occurrence.
<cite ref="Yevamot 116b:11-15">Ib.</cite> <he>בירדן … דהוה מ׳ וכ׳</he> only for the Jordan and for a ship exactly as the event took place, they established the ordinance &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 1:1">Ber. I, 1</cite> <he>מ׳ ובאו וכ׳</he> it happened that &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 3:2">Bets. III, 2</cite> <he>מעשה בעכו״ם וכ׳</he> it happened that a gentile brought &c.

Ib. 24ᵃ, a. fr. מ׳ לסתור you quote a fact which disproves your rule! Yeb. 70ᵇ מחוסר מ׳ ומ׳ בגופו he (the uncircumcised) lacks an act and this to be performed on his body; a. fr.—אנשי מ׳ (sub. נִסִּים) men in whose behalf miracles occur, saints.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 9:15">Sot. IX, 15</cite>; a. fr.—<he>מַעֲשֵׂה מרכבה</he>, <he>מ׳ נסים</he> &c., v. respective determinants.—Pl. <he>מַעֲשִׂים</he>, constr. <cite ref="M02188"><he>מַעֲשֵׂי</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 95b:16">B. Kam. 95ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>הא מ׳ בכל יום</he> is it not a daily occurrence? <cite ref="Tosefta Niddah 4:3">Tosef. Nidd. IV, 3</cite> <he>שני מ׳ הוליך וכ׳</he> my father brought the report of two precedents from Tibin to Jabneh.
<cite ref="Berakhot 32b:5">Ber. 32ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ טובים</he> good deeds; a. v. fr.
